body:
I have to say I think Kava sucks. It tastes really bad. When I make a drink out it if looks like diarrhea water. It's the most awful tasting stuff in the world.
It kind of makes me feel drunk in a way but then it wears off and makes me feel all tweaky and anxious. I'm done with this junk it tastes like shit if I want to feel relaxed I'll just buy a 6-pack of beer. It's like dirty pepper diarrhea water it's the most disgusting stuff ever and when it wears off I feel horrible.
Kava Kava sucks.
